description: Datadog monitors for Video Classrooms (#2230). All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [Video Classrooms] Zero room creation activity
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No video classroom rooms have been created in the last 10 minutes. This could indicate a complete outage of the video classrooms pipeline or zero user engagement.

**Actions:**
1. Check the Video Classrooms API health endpoint.
2. Verify the NestJS backend is running and LiveKit connection is healthy.
3. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Video Classrooms] High room creation failure rate
[Video Classrooms] High room join failure rate
[Video Classrooms] Token generation latency high
[Video Classrooms] Low active room count
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No active video classrooms detected in the last 10 minutes. This may indicate a service disruption or a drop in user engagement.

**Actions:**
1. Check health of LiveKit webhook ingestion.
2. Verify room lifecycle events are being processed correctly.
3. Review recent deployments for regressions.
{{/is_alert}}
